# UI library

Reactive state and ready-made components (layouts, buttons, inputs, lists, themes) on top of the SDK. Start here unless you want to write all of the HTML yourself; use the SDK directly for anything the UI library does not wrap.

It works the same on Linux and Windows; the few real differences are listed in [Linux and Windows](../getting-started/platforms.md).
